description: Merges answers into the application's questionnaire (keys from get_application_fields). A select takes an option's value or label, a checkbox true or false, a date YYYY-MM-DD; normalized lists what was converted. A key the form does not have, or a value it does not take, refuses the whole call with 422 (rejected names the allowed values) and saves nothing. Omitted keys keep their values; null clears one. Saving the same answers twice changes nothing. The answer lists what is still missing (answers.missing, documents.missing): an answer can open new fields. dry_run: true checks the same and saves nothing. Values a document's reading gave (get_application_fields, documents.items[].files[].read.answers) are saved only through this call: check them with the person first.

dry_run.description: true: check and answer what a save would do, save nothing

name: visarun_save_answers
title: Save answers
